name: leveraged-xlm-borrow
description: 20,000 XLM against 16,000 USDC, flat 1.0 oracle. Weighted collateral is exactly 16,000, equal to the debt, so the health factor sits on 1.0 — the boundary itself. The contract still treats it as healthy, but any fall in the collateral crosses it, which is the position a leveraged borrower is actually exposed to.
